run_pipeline_stg_cogvideox: run the CogVideoXSTGPipeline to generate a video from a text prompt using spatio-temporal guidance
configure_stg_parameters: configure spatio-temporal guidance parameters including applied layer indices, scale factor, and rescaling option
encode_text_prompts: encode text prompts into hidden state embeddings using T5 encoder with configurable sequence length and batch handling
prepare_video_latents: prepare initial noise latents with proper shape for video generation based on frame count, height, width, and channel dimensions
denoise_video_latents: denoise video latents through the transformer diffusion loop with classifier-free guidance and optional spatio-temporal guidance
